repository_history.outcome: Event Resolve Rate: current and all earlier non-superseded hidden tests pass
repository_history.design: 100 three-event episodes from 50 Python repositories; fresh session per event; five systems and two models
notes: Cohorts overlap and are not independent studies.
Cohort membership depends on the Agent-History starting state.
The filtered clean cohort excludes pre-solved tasks and unevaluable starting tests.
Differences and intervals are transcribed as published, not recomputed from rounded rates.

rows.label: Passing start; next task not pre-solved

instruction_maintenance.design: Random sample of commits modifying agent context files, excluding each file's creation; independent coding and adjudication
notes: Labels can overlap within a commit; counts do not represent disjoint sets of commits.
Addition labels combine 48 line-level and 30 section-level assignments; 66 distinct commits contain an addition.
Deletion labels combine 15 line-level and four section-level assignments.
The maintenance count is 139 minus the 129 published add, fix and delete assignments; only eight commits are maintenance-only.
These counts measure edit types, not added tokens, net growth, failure-triggered corrections or agent performance.
